title: Red panda holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M52 42 Q56 50 54 58' stroke='#C8B8D8' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='28' rx='13' ry='16' fill='#FF4A6B'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='28' rx='13' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#FF8FA3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='23' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#FFB3C1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M52 43 L55 46 L58 43 Z' fill='#FF4A6B'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#C44A1A'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#F0A060'/>
  <!-- left arm (holding string) -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='64' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#B03E12' transform='rotate(-30 30 64)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='58' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2A1A10'/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='66' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#B03E12' transform='rotate(25 70 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='60' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2A1A10'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='88' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#8A2E0A'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='88' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#8A2E0A'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#D4561E'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='33' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#C44A1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='33' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#F0A060'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='33' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#C44A1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='33' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#F0A060'/>
  <!-- face white markings -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#F8E0C8'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='43' rx='6' ry='6' fill='#F8E0C8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='43' rx='6' ry='6' fill='#F8E0C8'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='45' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#3A1A0A'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='45' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#3A1A0A'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='44' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='44' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2A1A10'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 55 Q47 58 45 56' stroke='#8A5A3A' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 55 Q53 58 55 56' stroke='#8A5A3A' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='50' r='3' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='50' r='3' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- stripe markings on cheeks -->
  <path d='M32 47 L28 46' stroke='#F8E0C8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M32 50 L28 50' stroke='#F8E0C8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 47 L72 46' stroke='#F8E0C8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 50 L72 50' stroke='#F8E0C8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
